Show less Read more Like 9 Dislike Reply · 4 replies · Hide replies · 4 replies @SteveSmith-cm1hx 2 months ago I have had my 65inch S90F since December of last year and is it still good in 2026? Hell yes. And it will still be good beyond 2026. Samsung for some stupid reason went and put a matte screen on their new S90H for 2026 and it will be on the S95H obviously so there goes gloss QD OLED screens. So for me the S90F would be the only choice when it comes to Samsung OLED. A friend of mine who's a pretty big Youtube reviewer said that the S90F is the last of its kind and he is right. In my opinion my S90F is the best tv I have ever owned and I have owned alot of high end tv's over the years. From build quality to picture quality you name it this tv checks all the boxes I have ever looked for in a tv and it has delivered in every possible way. My only nitpick is I wish Samsung would have had it come with the one connect box. I know they had their issues and not everyone liked them but I thought they were cool as hell. Samsung from what I understand has done away with those as well. But yes the S90F is still more then worth it in 2026 and I suggest to those looking to buy an OLED tv to get while they can.
